QuestInfo.name: A Carpenter in My Own Right!
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, is finally ready to acknowledge my woodcrafting skills.
QuestInfo.1: #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, was impressed by how much I've grown and suggested I show off my abilities. I need to defeat #r#o20#s#k and craft #b#t3010002##k to bring back to him.
QuestInfo.2: #p208#, the carpenter of #m10001000#, admired my craftsmanship and handed me a #t4130001#. It seems to be a special item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's stats. Maybe I should give it a try.

0.0: Rumors that you've become a proper carpenter have made their way here to #m10001000#. Naturally, I wanted to see for myself if they were true. You seem to have built up quite a bit of skill and experience--shall we take a look at your work?

yes.0: You sound confident! Very well, then. Please defeat #r#o20#s#k near #m10004000# and craft #b1 #t3010002##k for me. I'll be looking forward to it.

no.0: It seems you haven't quite reached that level yet. I'm afraid woodcrafting isn't something you can take lightly.

1.0: Let's see... This truly is well made! I'm honestly impressed that you've built up this level of skill. I'd say this is more than enough to be called a proper carpenter. I admire the dedication you've shown in honing your craft. All right... I suppose I should give you a special gift.

yes.0: This #t4130001# is a special item that can be used during crafting to alter an equipment's abilities. It's quite delicate, so the results may sometimes be disappointing--but if handled carefully, it could produce something beyond your expectations.
yes.1: If you'd like to test the limits of your woodcrafting skills, I highly recommend giving it a try. Please keep striving forward!

mob.0: It looks like you haven't defeated all the monsters I mentioned. Show me what you can do!

item.0: It looks like you haven't gathered the material I asked for. Show me what you can do!
